content:
medbridge_it: Hi Redwood — our security team flagged an issue after our scheduled KMS rotation. We're seeing 401s for the service account used by our integration and the audit logs show missing KMS decrypt events around 2026-06-10T14:22Z. Correlation ID: c-9a12f. Can someone help reproduce and advise mitigation?

sara_support: sorry to hear that, we're on it. Can you confirm whether this is Private (VPC) or Dedicated? Also, do you have the exact service account email and key alias used? :mag:

medbridge_it: It's Private (on-prem package). Service account is svc-medbridge-infer@medbridge-prod. Key alias is projects/medbridge/locations/global/keyRings/rr/cryptoKeys/medbridge-infer-key.

devin_se: @sara_support looping in infra folks. Two quick asks to repro: 1) the last successful API call ts (if available), 2) an example request/response with headers (redact tokens). If you can paste the curl that failed that helps.

medbridge_it: here's a redacted curl and response we captured:

```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"summary"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

< HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
< Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2026 14:22:13 GMT
< x-request-id: c-9a12f
< content-type: application/json

{"error":{"code":401,"message":"invalid api key or key wrapped by unknown KMS key","details":[]}}
```

medbridge_it: audit snippet shows no decrypt entry at that minute for the key (we checked our KMS audit export).

maria_gcpops: looking. For Private deployments we rely on the local KMS proxy to forward decrypt to your KMS/HSM. Two possibilities: key alias aliasing mismatch after rotation, or the proxy failed to refresh credentials. I'll tail the collector logs. Can you confirm whether you rotated the key material in your KMS or created a new version?

medbridge_it: we rotated to new version (v3) and set it as primary. We also rotated vault CA certs same morning.

sam_kms: fyi from KMS side, rotating to a new primary version alone shouldn't break decrypts if aliases remain. But if a new key resource was created (different resource id) or the cryptoKeyVersion was used in envelope keys by Redwood, mapping can break. Also HSM-backed keys can have additional ACLs.

sara_support: @medbridge_it thanks — can you run this quick repro to confirm mapping issue?

1) Try an API call with an API key issued before rotation (should 401).
2) Re-issue a new API key from Console -> API keys and test immediately.
3) If new key works, we know the issue is key-wrapping of existing tokens.

medbridge_it: did step 1 -> 401 (same). Step 2 -> new key works.

devin_se: that strongly indicates the stored wrapped key material in Redwood's private deployment couldn't be unwrapped w/ the new KMS key version. Likely we cached the old key material. We'll need to rewrap tokens or trigger a key sync.

maria_gcpops: I found errors in the kms-proxy logs on the host during rotation:

```
2026-06-10T14:21:58Z ERROR kms-proxy: decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = requestor is not allowed to use cryptoKeyVersion "projects/medbridge/locations/global/keyRings/rr/cryptoKeys/medbridge-infer-key/cryptoKeyVersions/3"
2026-06-10T14:22:02Z WARN kms-proxy: fallback to local cache failed: cache miss for key_id=medbridge-infer-key:v2
```

maria_gcpops: looks like permission/ACL on the new cryptoKeyVersion not granted to the proxy principal. Could be HSM policy (Cloud HSM) or IAM binding missing.

sam_kms: confirm IAM: serviceAccount:redwood-proxy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com needs roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the new cryptoKeyVersion/resource. Also HSM keys require binding when a key is imported or rotated.

legal_jena: quick note from BAA perspective — we need a timestamped record of what data was accessible and the audit log status during the window. Please export the audit logs for 2026-06-10T14:15 -> 14:30 UTC and attach securely. We may need to update the addendum if retention settings prevented capture.

sara_support: @medbridge_it next steps for mitigation: 1) grant decrypter role to redwood-proxy principal on the new version, 2) if immediate unblock needed, re-issue Redwood-side wrapped keys by triggering a key-sync endpoint (we can run safe rewrap job), 3) we'll preserve all related audit logs and snapshots for legal.

medbridge_it: ACLs added for decrypter role and we re-tested -> existing API keys still 401. What's the safe way to trigger rewrap?

devin_se: we'll run a rewrap job that attempts to unwrap cached envelopes with the KMS and rewrite them with the primary version. For Private customers we require your explicit consent to run rewrap since it's an operation that touches wrapped key material. Please reply in-thread with `consent: rewrap` if you want us to proceed.

medbridge_it: consent: rewrap. Also we'll attach the audit export to a secure upload link.

sara_support: ack. @deploy-bot scheduling rewrap job on private pool medbridge-vpc-12. Estimated completion ~ 8 minutes. We'll post job logs when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: [job 0x7bff] scheduled -> medbridge/rewrap/1763004321, started at 2026-06-10T14:28:00Z

maria_gcpops: rewrap job logs show success for 98% keys, 2% had HSM policy deny. Errors: 

```
rewrap: key medbridge-infer-key:v2 -> v3 status=ok
rewrap: key medbridge-infer-key:v1 -> v3 status=ok
rewrap: key medbridge-infer-key:v3 status=fail reason=HSM_POLICY_DENY (requires import token)
```

maria_gcpops: the entries that failed are HSM-protected versions that need an import token or manual unwrap in your HSM. We'll provide exact list and recommended steps.

sam_kms: for HSM-protected versions we'll need your HSM admin to either export the wrapped key or provide a transient unwrap token to Redwood (via the secure channel). We do not store raw key material.

medbridge_it: we'll engage our HSM admin. For the moment new API keys are working so we can keep traffic flowing. What will you provide for legal/audit?

legal_jena: we'll bundle the following artifacts: time-bound audit export for the 15-minute window, kms-proxy logs, rewrap job runbook and output, list of keys that failed and the error codes, and the consent record. That satisfies the BAA documentation needs. If retention settings prevented capture we'll propose an addendum clause to extend audit retention for Private deployments.

sara_support: summary and action items:
- Cause: KMS key version ACLs and HSM policy prevented Redwood's proxy from decrypting wrapped tokens during rotation -> 401s for pre-rotation API keys.
- Workaround: issue new API keys (done) or run rewrap (consent given, 98% success).
- Remediation: ensure proxy principal has Decrypter role on new key versions and coordinate HSM import tokens for HSM-protected versions.
- Legal: Redwood will supply artifacts and we will discuss audit retention addendum if needed.

sara_support: @medbridge_it we'll follow up with a private ticket and a secure file link for your audit exports. ETA for final writeup by EOD PST today. Anything else?

medbridge_it: that's great, appreciate the fast turnaround. Please include the exact list of HSM-only keys that failed so our admin can act.

maria_gcpops: will attach list in ticket. Closing the Slack thread but leaving notes here for traceability. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
